records.quote: Theorem 2: Let X1 ~ APTQLD(α1, β1, θ1) and X2 ~ APTQLD(α2, β2, θ2). If α1 < α2, β1 = β2 = β and θ1 = θ2 = θ, then X1 ≤lr X2. ... It is certain that for α1 < α2, β1 = β2 = β and θ1 = θ2 = θ, d log(f1(x)/f2(x))/dx < 0. Under these conditions, X1 is stochastically smaller than X2 in the likelihood ratio order.
records.family: alpha power transformed quasi Lindley APTQLD(α, β, θ)
records.compared: X1 vs X2 differing only in the alpha-power parameter

hypotheses.formal: only α varies; ordered α-power parameters

records.quantifiers: x > 0; parameters positive (log α terms require α > 0, proof uses log α1, log α2)
records.ambiguity: Proof is the displayed derivative of the log density ratio, asserted negative; algebra heavily OCR-garbled.

records.quote: Notably, if (X1 ≤lr X2), then (X1 ≤hr X2), (X1 ≤mrl X2) and (X1 ≤st X2).

hypotheses.text: α1 < α2, β1 = β2 = β, θ1 = θ2 = θ (so X1 ≤lr X2 by Theorem 2)

conclusion.direction: X1 ≤hr X2 (via printed lr ⇒ hr/mrl/st implication)

records.ambiguity: Section 3.5 defines ≤hr via h1/h2 decreasing — a hazard-ratio convention, noted verbatim.

records.ambiguity: Paper's mrl definition prints E(X − t | X < t) — reversed conditioning (mean inactivity), a likely typo.

records.quote: Notably, if (X1 ≤lr X2), then (X1 ≤hr X2), (X1 ≤mrl X2) and (X1 ≤st X2).

note: Theorem 2 prints lr with the 'Notably' sentence adding hr/mrl/st via implication; split into one record per order.

records.quote: X1 is smaller than X2 in: a) stochastic order (X1 ≤st X2) if R1(x,α1,β1,θ1) ≤ R2(x,α2,β2,θ2); b) hazard rate order (X1 ≤hr X2) if h1(x,α1,β1,θ1)/h2(x,α2,β2,θ2) is decreasing in x; c) mean residual life order (X1 ≤mrl X2) if E(X1−t|X1<t) ≤ E(X2−t|X2<t); d) likelihood ratio order (X1 ≤lr X2) if f1(x,α1,β1,θ1)/f2(x,α2,β2,θ2) is a decreasing function of x. Notably, if (X1 ≤lr X2), then (X1 ≤hr X2), (X1 ≤mrl X2) and (X1 ≤st X2).

conclusion.direction: X1 ≤lr X2 ⇒ X1 ≤hr X2, X1 ≤mrl X2, X1 ≤st X2 (printed chain grounding Theorem 2's corollaries)

records.ambiguity: Definitions block plus the implication sentence. The mrl definition prints E(X−t|X<t) — reversed (mean-inactivity) conditioning, likely a typo; the hr definition uses decreasing hazard-ratio h1/h2 rather than the standard pointwise-hazard convention.

note: Definitions + printed lr⇒hr/mrl/st chain; kept since it is the paper's stated basis for Theorem 2's remaining orders.
